For tasks (build, lint, test, e2e, etc.), always prefer `nx run`, `nx run-many`, `nx affected` over underlying tooling. Use Nx MCP tools. For repository questions, use `nx_workspace` first where applicable; for individual projects, use `nx_project_details`; for Nx configuration questions, best practices, or uncertainty, always use `nx_docs` instead of assuming. For Nx configuration/project graph errors, use `nx_workspace` to get errors.
<!-- nx configuration end-->

Next.js 16 App Router, strict TypeScript, Supabase, TanStack Query v5, HeroUI v2, Tailwind CSS v4, Vitest; TJ Sokol Svinov club system. All user-facing strings must be in Czech.

Use `.claude/skills/` proactively: `/new-entity` for new table/model/CRUD (Do not scaffold files manually; invoke this skill.); `/db-sync` after DB migration or schema/type mismatch; `/new-migration` for new table, column, function, view, or RLS policy; `/generate-barrels` after adding, renaming, or removing hook/component/type/enum files (run before committing); `/review-pr` for code/PR review or “check my changes”. Follow these patterns strictly. Do not deviate without explicit user instruction.

Entity layout: `src/types/entities/{camelCase}/schema/{camelCase}Schema.ts` (auto-generated); `data/{camelCase}.ts` (domain types extending schema); `src/queries/{pluralCamel}/`: `constants.ts` (DB_TABLE + ENTITY), `queries.ts` (reads), `mutations.ts` (writes), `index.ts` (barrel); `src/hooks/entities/{kebab-case}/data/useFetch{Entity}s.ts`; `state/use{Entity}.ts`; `src/lib/translations/{pluralCamel}.ts`.

Client/browser: `supabaseBrowserClient()` from `@/utils/supabase/client`; server component: `supabaseServerClient()` from `@/utils/supabase/server`; authenticated API: `withAuth(handler)`; admin API: `withAdminAuth(handler)`; public API: `withPublicAccess(handler)` from `@/utils/supabase/apiHelpers`. Coach role checks: `hasCoachRole()` / `isAdmin()` / `checkCoachCardAccess()` from `@/utils/supabase/coachAuth` — auth helpers, not clients. Never import a server client in a client component or vice versa. Prefer `apiHelpers` wrappers over calling `supabaseServerClient()` directly in API routes —
